title: Bangsamoro human rights body asks CHR to probe death of Moro woman

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Basilan provincial office of the Bangsamoro Human Rights Commission (BHRC) has asked the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) to investigate the death of a Basilan woman who was killed when a military cargo truck driven by a Marines soldier hit her motorcycle in Manila last week. In a statement issued on Thursday, Oct. 15, the BHRC Basilan Provincial Office said it referred the case to the CHR as an alleged violation of the right to life by state agents.
